units.source_excerpt: Dear Members of the Juneau Tourist Council, Juneau received a record 1.6 million cruise passengers in 2023. Tourism brought economic benefits, but it also intensified overcrowding, resource use, housing pressure, and ecological strain, especially around Mendenhall Glacier. A balance between tourism income and long-term environmental and community welfare is urgent.
